features.name: Bent-wood side panel sweeping from the base up to the arm
features.note: Boxy slab: near-vertical front edge, small bottom radius, straight diagonal to the arm; the reference is a thin shell with one large front curve.

features.name: Flat paddle arm with a rounded front, on a front post
Thin wooden front rail that wraps the front corners
features.note: Reads as a separate bar rather than the shell's lower edge.

features.name: Tapered legs splayed outward, set under the side panels
Three thick seat cushions with flat fronts
features.note: Edges a little rounder; less overhang over the rail.

features.name: Three back cushions, 4 x 2 biscuit tufting
features.note: Grid is cut lines on a flat face, not puffed biscuits; the horizontal seam runs past the grid.

features.name: Back cushions lean back; no frame shows above them
features.note: Taller and more upright than the reference.

features.name: Side panel rises behind the arm toward the back cushions
features.note: Rise is shorter than the reference.

differences: Thin bent-wood shell: front edge one large radius (300-400 mm) from the rail up to the arm post
Top edge parallel under the arm along its full length; no diagonal
Front rail as the continuous lower edge of the shell; legs under that line
Puffed biscuit tufts with short, deep seams that stop at the grid edges
Back cushions lower and tilted back 15-20 degrees; rear of the side panel sweeps up following the cushion back
